title: Viking Graffiti in Constantinople
hook: Inside the Hagia Sophia cathedral, you can still read runes saying: 'Halfdan was here.'

scenes.text: In the 9th and 10th centuries, Norse warriors sailed down Russian riverways to reach Constantinople—which they called 'Miklagard', the Great City.
